source_evidence: Player exact 'Yes lets rest for the night' authorizes completing the already paid secure Copper Hart overnight. No dice necessary in secure inn with no known intervening threat. Standing pre-rest limited-resource rule not triggered because V full HP and Psi. Apply actual Short Rest and weighted2 units to prior3/6, now5/6; no full Long Rest or refreshed long-rest-only resources. No extra food/feed debit because D324 full travel-day charge already taken and inn package paid, no invented breakfast bill. Routine D325 Sending Stone administrative contact with Tamsin, no specific estate result. No other player action assumed. D325~08:00, Copper Hart Inn, Orsaven. V expressly chose to rest overnight. D324→325 uninterrupted secure city overnight, ordinary Short Rest and +2 weighted Long Rest units3→5/6, not a completed Long Rest. All HP and short-rest resources already full, no Psi Recovery expenditure at full Psi, no Second Wind or Hit Dice used; Cirren second-level slots2/3 and Fenar Rage3/4 remain depleted until actual Long Rest. Previously paid2gp two-room package covers night's lodging, three non-V suppers and four horses' care/stabling, no second charge or packed provision deduction. No additional meal fee inferred. V purse2311gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28. Routine D325 Tamsin stone exchange under standing authorization, no specific new estate outcome asserted. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped, old ordinary shield retained, HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 Boots of Elvenkind, no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia of Claws equipped HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or+8 damage raging, mechanical greataxe Double-Claw Rend unchanged; Mara, coach and four horses healthy. Tobin's private second reply received324, willing to continue correspondence, no meeting agreed; other previously checked mail unchanged. V retains sealed Crownsunder invitation and messenger credentials, separate Crown frontier commission introduction and Kestrel originals; Mara notes, Fenar exhibits, Cirren compact unchanged. No diplomatic delivery yet, no appointment, map-room visit, new quest or new payment; Crown frontier300+1300 and Coris300/800 contingent. Elara in Caereth; Severin assent unconfirmed. Property purchases deferred. Existing three enchanted equipment inquiries remain open. V dice delegated until stop. Await V's morning decision at Copper Hart.
